conventions.month: Mars month k = solar longitude Ls 30(k-1) to 30k; Ls 0 = northern spring equinox; months differ in length (sols given)
conventions.measured: true = data taken at this place (lander/rover record, orbital map read at this point, or exact orbital geometry); false = global predictor from latitude, elevation and surface properties; value null = no data and no defensible prediction
conventions.low_high: measured: 10th-90th percentile of daily values in the month; predicted: validated model error band
conventions.storm_year: same month in a global dust storm year (TES, 2001)
conventions.target_profile: team spec Component 3 features in spec order with spec units; features_measured holds the yes/no per feature. Normalisation to [0,1] is left to the Earth search, which owns the Earth min/max ranges.

weights.rationale: Rocky outflow-channel plains: surface texture and rock cover define the site.
weights.meaning: importance of each feature for finding an Earth analog of this place (0-1, adjustable)
